title: Generic comparison by ideal multiples on a reduced irreducible algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Noetherian means locally Noetherian on etale scheme charts [pqf-def-locnoeth], quasi-compact, and quasi-separated; the last two conditions mean that every open cover has a finite subcover and the diagonal is quasi-compact on scheme tests. Modules are on the small etale ringed site, with quasi-coherence as in [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. On a locally Noetherian space, coherent means quasi-coherent with coherent pullbacks on all etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. Write $\operatorname{Supp}(M)$ for the locus of nonzero geometric stalks, with the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. A closed immersion is representable and a closed immersion after every scheme base change [def-weil-closed-immersion]; reduced means that etale scheme charts have local rings without nonzero nilpotents, and irreducible means nonempty and not the union of two proper closed subsets. Assume $X$ is Noetherian and reduced, with $|X|$ irreducible. Let $G,H$ be coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules with $\operatorname{Supp}(G)=\operatorname{Supp}(H)=|X|$. Then there exist integers $a,b\geq1$, a nonzero quasi-coherent ideal $J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$, a nonempty open subspace $V\subseteq X$, and an injective module morphism $$\alpha:(JG)^{\oplus a}\longrightarrow H^{\oplus b}$$ such that $J|_V=\mathcal O_V$ and $\alpha|_V:G|_V^{\oplus a}\longrightarrow H|_V^{\oplus b}$ is an isomorphism. The submodule $JG\subseteq G$ is generated locally by products of sections of $J$ and $G$, and $(-)^{\oplus a}$ denotes the finite direct sum of $a$ copies.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-generic-freeness] to $G$ and $H$. Intersect the resulting nonempty opens; irreducibility makes their intersection $V$ nonempty. On $V$ write $G|_V\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus r}$ and $H|_V\cong\mathcal O_V^{\oplus s}$ with $r,s\geq1$. Set $a=s$, $b=r$. Reindexing the $rs$ summands gives an isomorphism $u:G|_V^{\oplus a}\to H|_V^{\oplus b}$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, last proof paragraph: choice of generic ranks and common open.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-space-reduced-closed-support] for $T=|X|\setminus|V|$, obtaining $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$. By [lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules], its defining ideal $I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ is quasi-coherent. On scheme charts it defines precisely $T$, so $I|_V=\mathcal O_V$ and $V=X\setminus Z(I)$. By [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support], $I$ is coherent. Every $I^nG$ is coherent: on an affine etale chart, products of finite generating sets of $I$ and $G$ generate $I^nG$, which is a coherent submodule by the cited support lemma. Finite direct sums of coherent modules are coherent, by induction on the split exact sequences and [lem-sfb-space-coherent-kernel-cokernel-extension].

source.place: Tag 07UT, choice of an ideal cutting out the complement; Tag 07UQ, choice of the ideal.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-homs-over-open] with coherent source $G^{\oplus a}$, target $H^{\oplus b}$ and ideal $I$. Obtain $n\geq0$ and $f:I^n(G^{\oplus a})\to H^{\oplus b}$ extending $u$. Ideal multiplication acts coordinatewise, hence $M=I^n(G^{\oplus a})=(I^nG)^{\oplus a}$. Both source and target are coherent by Step 2. Thus $K=\ker f$ is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-coherent-kernel-cokernel-extension]. Restriction computes kernels sectionwise, so $K|_V=0$ and $\operatorname{Supp}(K)\subseteq Z(I)$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, extension of the comparison morphism and description of its kernel.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-power-ideal-kills], choose $d\geq0$ with $I^dK=0$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-artin-rees] to $K\subseteq M$ and $I$, obtaining $c\geq0$. For $m=c+d$ its formula gives $$I^mM\cap K=I^{m-c}(I^cM\cap K)\subseteq I^dK=0.$$ The restriction of $f$ to $I^mM$ therefore has zero kernel. By associativity of local products, $I^mM=(I^{n+m}G)^{\oplus a}$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, kernel annihilation and Artin-Rees; Tags 07UK and 07UL.

proof.text: Set $J=I^{n+m}$ and let $\alpha$ be this restriction of $f$. Products of local ideal generators define a quasi-coherent ideal, coherent by Step 2. Since $I|_V=\mathcal O_V$, also $J|_V=\mathcal O_V$ and $\alpha|_V=u$. The nonempty open $V$ has nonzero structure sheaf (a nonempty scheme chart has a nonzero local ring), so $J$ cannot be zero. Thus $a,b,J,V,\alpha$ satisfy every asserted clause.

source.place: Tag 07UT, end of the comparison construction before applying (3)(b).

lean.note: The ideal product is retained with its inclusion and characterized as the least submodule containing all local products; finite products represent finite direct sums. On each etale chart over the nonempty open, both the actual ideal inclusion and product inclusion, and the same comparison map, are isomorphisms. Coherence is expressed by quasi-coherence and chartwise quasi-coherent finite type under the locally Noetherian hypothesis.
